SEBI PLANS CAPACITY-BUILDING NETWORK FOR INDEPENDENT DIRECTORS

SEBI announced it is working on a capacity‑building network to train independent directors, partnering with NISM, industry bodies and academic institutions.

The initiative will promote peer learning, strengthen boardroom oversight and help directors navigate emerging technology risks, boosting corporate governance standards.

For information only. Not investment advice.
